evidence.description: Four outcome-derived organ formulas, closed envelopes, half-open periods, winner selection, and privacy-safe references were inspected against REQ-001 through REQ-009.
Fresh deterministic evaluation exited 0 with calendar 21/21, late 12/12, context 12/12, and score 27/27.

Fresh official harness exited 0 with roles=3, snapshot_sessions=2, complete_rows=20000, and overflow_rows=20001; the independent probes expose cases outside its coverage.

The independent oracle imports none of panel-score-semantics.js, panel-api.js, or panel-ui.js.
Fresh full Life Call regression exited 0; the score suite reported 14/14 with zero failed, skipped, or todo tests.
Official VCSDD runtime returned valid=true with warnings=[].
TEST-001 through TEST-016 are green and linked, and PROP-001 through PROP-006 remain required and pending for Phase 5.
